revisions.criteria: The registered rule is /holdout_spearman > 0. Report the observed direction and magnitude on the eligible held-out rows, and reserve prospective qualification for evidence matching the registered scope.
revisions.limitations: The registered scope covers the S1 acquisition. Each eligible row was an alanine substitution at a different site. On these pairs the S1 WT had median absolute log10 error 0.388205 log10. Its rank correlation is undefined because its prediction is constant.
